label: Remifentanil PK — Eleveld (2017, general-purpose)

extraction.tier_rationale: Allometric (fat-free-mass) general-purpose model; reference 35 y, 70 kg, 170 cm, male. Kernel validated to reproduce the reference individual; transcription pending human PDF confirmation.
Hypnos uses V3ref=5.03 (the published reference); an open R implementation transcribes V3 from V2ref, which does not reproduce the paper's reference value.
Fast effect-site equilibration (ke0 ~1.09); markedly faster than Minto (~0.6), a key source of Minto-vs-Eleveld effect-site divergence.
Eleveld 2017 builds its allometric SIZE descriptor from Al-Sallami (2015) age-aware FFM; every volume and clearance scales on it. Monotone in weight (no James inversion).
extraction.source_locator: Eleveld 2017, covariate model (size = FFM by Al-Sallami)

organ_tolerance.basis: Remifentanil is cleared by nonspecific blood and tissue esterases, so its clearance is essentially independent of hepatic function — severe liver disease did not alter remifentanil pharmacokinetics.
Esterase metabolism is independent of renal function; parent remifentanil pharmacokinetics are unchanged in renal failure.
organ_tolerance.caveat: The active carboxylic-acid metabolite (GR90291) is renally eliminated and accumulates in renal impairment; the parent-drug PK this model predicts is unaffected.

extraction.tier_rationale: General-purpose allometric remifentanil model spanning neonates to the obese elderly; the broad-envelope counterpart to Minto. Kernel transcribed from the published equations and cross-checked against the tci R package (with a V3ref correction; see V3 note), validated to reproduce the reference individual exactly. review_status remains UNVERIFIED: an LLM transcription is not a human PDF verification.

notes: Kernel = remifentanil_eleveld_2017. Concentrations internally in ug/mL (= ng/mL / 1000). FFM via Al-Sallami 2015. Pairs with Minto for a remifentanil model-divergence comparison (Eleveld's faster ke0 vs Minto's age-dependent ke0). Validated reference (35 y, 70 kg, 170 cm, male): V1=5.81, V2=8.82, V3=5.03, CL=2.58, Q2=1.72, Q3=0.124, ke0=1.09.
